title: NIH RePORTER Research Grants
description: NIH-funded research projects from RePORTER: project number, title, fiscal year, award amount with direct and indirect costs, organization and location, principal investigators, institute, activity code, dates, abstract and terms.
useCases: Life-science vendors finding labs with fresh funding
Biotech BD and investors tracking research areas
Grant writers and research offices benchmarking

text.title: Search text
text.description: Matched against title, terms and abstract.

limits: Sorted by award amount. RePORTER caps a search at 15,000 results.
